fields.description:
Verify the on-box rebar MCP server works for copilot, codex, and claude via basic CLI commands
against the LIVE AWS endpoint (nginx `/mcp/` TLS edge + `static` bearer, per ADR
deft-evolutive-mosasaur). Approval-gated and human-performed: requires the deploy (esok) + client
configs (olm) to be in place. Single concern: the live 3-client smoke — no code change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Each of the three clients (copilot/codex/claude), configured per olm with its bearer PAT, lists the
  `rebar` MCP server and executes at least one basic read tool (e.g. ticket `show`/`list`)
  successfully against the live `/mcp/` endpoint. Oracle: a real tool result returned to each client.
- [x] An invalid/absent bearer is rejected (401) at the edge (confirms auth is live, not open).
- [x] Record the run (client + command + result) as a comment on this ticket for the audit trail.

## Verification
Read-only live smoke; each proving command and its expected result:
- Server listed per client: `claude mcp list` (shows `rebar ... ✔ Connected`), `codex mcp list`
  (shows `rebar ... enabled`), `copilot mcp list` (shows `rebar (http)`).
- Read tool executes per client (each with its own bearer PAT), asserting a real structured result:
  `codex exec "call rebar list_tickets"`, `copilot -p "call rebar list_tickets" --allow-tool mcp__rebar`,
  and `claude -p "call rebar list_tickets" --allowedTools mcp__rebar__list_tickets` — oracle: a
  `{"result":[...]}` tool result with no error returned to each client.
- Edge auth is live, not open:
  `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/mcp` with no bearer
  and with an invalid bearer both return `401`; a valid PAT gets past auth.
- Evidence recorded: the run (client + command + result) is captured as a comment on this ticket.

## Notes
This is the only slice that touches prod live; a human performs it after esok/olm land. No rollback
(read-only verification).

Depends on: unmythical-uninspired-olm (client configs), and transitively the deploy (esok) + secrets
(avians).
